web-guide-idea-18.audience: Craft lovers who enjoy seeing skilled hands at work.
web-guide-idea-18.offer: Sell a narrated demonstration of one craft process, from raw material to a recognisable result. Close-up explanation is the value, even if the full object takes days.
web-guide-idea-18.steps.0: Choose a stage with visible progress.
web-guide-idea-18.steps.1: Position the camera on your hands and explain key decisions.
web-guide-idea-18.steps.2: Show a finished example and answer process questions.
web-guide-idea-18.equipment: A phone on a stand, good window light and your usual craft tools. An overhead angle may be more useful than a new camera.
web-guide-idea-18.returnReason: Develop a series around materials, techniques or commissions, with a different stage each time.
web-guide-idea-18.promotion: Share a before-and-after detail and name the technique you will demonstrate.
web-guide-idea-18.metadataTitle: Artisan At Work — Creator Idea & Practical Guide · Saathum
web-guide-idea-18.metadataDescription: Let viewers watch pottery, weaving, embroidery or woodworking while you explain the process. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
